name: Miori Shizuku
source:
Shizuku is the mother of the protagonist’s best friend and the woman who is his first love and object of longing.

A devoted wife and mother who supports her hardworking husband and takes care of their only son, Haruto. She has a gentle personality and always wears a kind smile.

She has known the protagonist (Wataru) since childhood, as her son Haruto’s best friend, and she frequently looks after him as if he were her own child.

She handles all household chores without issue, but her cooking — which she treats as both a duty and a hobby — is exceptionally good. Her dishes are on a level that could easily outshine a family restaurant in both presentation and taste.

Because her husband is often away at work, she spends most of her time at home. She enjoys physical activity, though she isn’t particularly athletic. Lately, she has become concerned about the gradual weight gain and loss of tone in her body due to lack of exercise.

With her beautiful appearance and outstanding figure, she has an overwhelming presence that draws the eyes of men around her, including her son Haruto and the protagonist.

Although Shizuku is blessed with excellent qualities as a woman, after giving birth to Haruto her husband became increasingly absorbed in his work to provide for the family and secure a better life. As a result, the frequency of their sexual relations dropped sharply.

While Shizuku wanted to have three children, her husband continued to receive high evaluations at work and steadily climbed the corporate ladder. Now that he has become an executive, his increased responsibilities and social obligations have led to him coming home late. Not only has having a second child become impossible, but they have fallen into a completely sexless marriage.

Shizuku would never voice her complaints out loud due to her personality, but deep down she is deeply dissatisfied with their sexless situation and struggles with constant sexual frustration.

(Machine Translated Description from the Eroit product page.)
